name: GeForce NOW Browser
postStartCommand: docker start chromium >/dev/null 2>&1 || docker run -d --name=chromium --restart unless-stopped --security-opt seccomp=unconfined -p 3000:3000 --shm-size=2gb -v ${containerWorkspaceFolder}/.chrome-data:/config -e CUSTOM_RES_W=1280 -e CUSTOM_RES_H=720 -e CUSTOM_RES_FPS=60 -e SELKIES_MANUAL_RESOLUTION=true\|locked -e SELKIES_MANUAL_WIDTH=1280 -e SELKIES_MANUAL_HEIGHT=720 -e SELKIES_ENABLE_RESIZE=false\|locked -e SELKIES_FRAMERATE=60,30-60 -e SELKIES_VIDEO_STREAMING_MODE=true\|locked -e SELKIES_BACKPRESSURE_QUEUE_SIZE=2 -e SELKIES_RATE_CONTROL_MODE=cbr -e SELKIES_VIDEO_BITRATE=6000,1000-6000 -e CHROME_CLI=https://play.geforcenow.com lscr.io/linuxserver/chromium:latest
